description: Ministry of Labour - Collective Agreement no 41 of 2024 between the National Saving Bank and Executive Officers Association of NSB
categorisation: The gazette content is the official publication of a Collective Agreement under the Industrial Disputes Act. Its primary purpose is to give legal force and public notice to this agreement, which establishes regulatory terms for employment, salaries, and benefits between a bank and a union. This falls squarely under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes," which include the publication of statutory instruments and regulations. It does not concern government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or other specialized categories like land or commerce.
